title: Stroke Data Cleaning and Descriptive Analysis
text:
This project presents a reproducible data quality assessment, cleaning workflow, and descriptive analysis of demographic, clinical, and lifestyle characteristics by stroke status.
The project focuses on transparent data cleaning, missing-data assessment, descriptive statistics, and age-stratified comparisons. It does not aim to develop a machine-learning prediction model or estimate causal effects.

title: Factors associated with stroke in adults: a multivariable analysis with multiple imputation
text:
Objective. To describe the factors associated with a history of stroke among adults, with a focus on the association between hypertension (primary exposure) and stroke, after adjustment for potential confounders.
Design. Cross-sectional analysis of a public dataset (source not documented; no follow-up time). Results are therefore associations, not causal effects and not incidence or prediction of future stroke.
Population. Adults (age >= 18 years).
Outcome. Stroke (binary, yes/no).
Covariates. Age, sex, heart disease, average glucose level, BMI, smoking status.
Missing data.

BMI is missing for a subset of adults. These participants are kept in the analysis using multivariate imputation by chained equations (MICE, m = 20), with the outcome included in the imputation model.
Smoking status “Unknown” is kept as its own category in the main model.
Sensitivity analyses: (1) complete-case analysis, (2) exclusion of “Unknown” smoking status.

Statistical model. Multivariable logistic regression; results as odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals, pooled across imputed datasets with Rubin’s rules.

5. Multivariable logistic regression


Code
# Extract pooled ORs with 95% CI from a mice pooled object
tidy_pool <- function(p) {
  # Version-independent: compute the CI from the pooled log-OR, its SE and
  # Rubin's degrees of freedom, then exponentiate.
  summary(p) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    transmute(
      term,
      estimate  = exp(estimate),
      conf.low  = exp(log(estimate) - qt(0.975, df) * std.error),
      conf.high = exp(log(estimate) + qt(0.975, df) * std.error),
      p.value
    )
}

# Fit a logistic model on each imputed dataset (data passed explicitly),
# then pool with Rubin's rules and return ORs with 95% CI
fit_pool <- function(imp, formula) {
  fits <- lapply(
    mice::complete(imp, "all"),
    function(d) glm(formula, data = d, family = binomial)
  )
  tidy_pool(pool(as.mira(fits)))
}

fmt_or <- function(est, lo, hi) sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", est, lo, hi)

6. Sensitivity analyses
Do the conclusions depend on how missing data are handled?


Code

fit_cc <- glm(model_formula, data = dat, family = binomial)
res_cc <- broom::tidy(fit_cc, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)

# (b) Exclude participants with unknown smoking status, MI for BMI
dat_known <- dat |>
  filter(smoking_status != "Unknown") |>
  mutate(smoking_status = droplevels(smoking_status))

imp_known <- mice(dat_known, m = 20, maxit = 10, seed = 2026, printFlag = FALSE)
res_known <- fit_pool(imp_known, model_formula)

lab_main  <- sprintf("Main: MI for BMI (n = %d)", nrow(dat))
lab_cc    <- sprintf("Complete case (n = %d)", nobs(fit_cc))
lab_known <- sprintf("Smoking known + MI (n = %d)", nrow(dat_known))

sens <- bind_rows(
  res_main  |> mutate(Analysis = lab_main),
  res_cc    |> mutate(Analysis = lab_cc),
  res_known |> mutate(Analysis = lab_known)

  mutate(OR = fmt_or(estimate, conf.low, conf.high)) |>
  select(Analysis, term, OR) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Analysis, values_from = OR) |>

text:
8. Discussion
Main findings. [Write 3-4 sentences: the primary exposure result, other clearly associated factors, and whether results were robust to missing-data handling.]
Strengths. All adults were retained through multiple imputation; crude and adjusted estimates and sensitivity analyses are reported.
Limitations.

Cross-sectional design and unknown source. No temporal ordering; the data provenance is undocumented, so generalisability is unknown. Findings are associations only.
Missing data. Multiple imputation assumes MAR. BMI was more often missing among people with stroke; if missingness depends on unobserved factors, estimates may still be biased.
Smoking status. “Unknown” was treated as a separate category; it may not be interchangeable with a true missing value.
Linearity. Glucose (and possibly BMI) was modelled linearly, although descriptive results suggest a non-linear pattern. Splines are a natural extension.
Adjustment set. Heart disease and glucose may lie on the pathway between hypertension and stroke, so the adjusted OR for hypertension may not represent its total association. No formal causal framework (e.g. a DAG) was used.
Residual confounding. Variables such as medication, family history and socioeconomic status are not available.
Odds ratios. With a stroke prevalence of around 5%, ORs approximate risk ratios reasonably well, but they are not identical.

Possible extensions. Natural splines for glucose and BMI; age-by-hypertension interaction; prediction models (logistic regression vs random forest) with class-imbalance handling and calibration.

Code
# Wilson 置信区间 / IC de Wilson
wilson_ci <- function(k, n) {
  if (n == 0) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  as.numeric(suppressWarnings(prop.test(k, n, correct = FALSE)$conf.int))
}

# 给表格加上「率」与置信区间（要求有 evenements 和 n 两列）
# ajoute taux et IC (le tableau doit contenir les colonnes evenements et n)
add_rate <- function(d) {
  ci <- t(mapply(wilson_ci, d$evenements, d$n))     # 每行一个 (下限, 上限) / une ligne (bas, haut) par modalité
  d$taux_pct  <- d$evenements / d$n * 100
  d$ic95_bas  <- ci[, 1] * 100
  d$ic95_haut <- ci[, 2] * 100
  d
}

# 每个类别的：样本数、事件数、中风率、区间 / par modalité : effectif, événements, taux, IC
rate_table <- function(data, var, order = NULL) {
  out <- data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(var))) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), evenements = sum(stroke), .groups = "drop")
  out$modalite <- as.character(out[[var]])
  out <- out[, c("modalite", "n", "evenements")]
  if (!is.null(order)) out <- out[match(order, out$modalite), ]   # 指定显示顺序 / imposer l'ordre
  add_rate(out)
}

# 卡方检验 p 值（期望频数<5 时不可靠，应改用 Fisher）/ p-valeur du khi-deux (peu fiable si effectifs attendus < 5)
chi2_p <- function(data, var) {
  ct <- table(data[[var]], data$stroke)
  ct <- ct[rowSums(ct) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  suppressWarnings(chisq.test(ct)$p.value)
}

6.2 辅助函数 / Fonctions : OR brut, Mantel-Haenszel
中文：R 自带 mantelhaen.test()，直接给出 Mantel-Haenszel 合并 OR 与置信区间（把每一层的 OR 加权合并 = 已「控制」分层变量）。 Français : R fournit mantelhaen.test() : OR commun de Mantel-Haenszel et son IC (les OR de chaque strate sont combinés → la variable de stratification est « contrôlée »).


Code
# 构造 2x2 表：行 = 暴露/未暴露，列 = 中风/未中风
# tableau 2x2 : lignes = exposé/non exposé, colonnes = AVC/pas d'AVC
two_by_two <- function(sub, exposure, exposed_value) {
  e <- sub[[exposure]] == exposed_value
  s <- sub$stroke == 1
  matrix(c(sum(e & s), sum(!e & s), sum(e & !s), sum(!e & !s)), nrow = 2,
         dimnames = list(c("expose", "non_expose"), c("AVC", "pas_AVC")))
}

# 粗 OR + Woolf 置信区间 / OR brut + IC de Woolf
crude_or <- function(tab) {
  a <- tab[1, 1]; b <- tab[1, 2]; c <- tab[2, 1]; d <- tab[2, 2]
  or <- (a * d) / (b * c)
  se <- sqrt(1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c + 1 / d)
  c(OR = or, IC_bas = exp(log(or) - 1.96 * se), IC_haut = exp(log(or) + 1.96 * se))
}

6.6 多因素逻辑回归 / Régression logistique multivariée
中文 - OR 解读：OR = 2 表示该组「中风的 odds」是参照组的 2 倍；OR = 1 表示无关联。OR ≠ 风险比：事件罕见时接近，否则 OR 会夸大。 - R 里用 glm(..., family = binomial)；confint.default() 给 Wald 区间（confint() 给轮廓似然区间，略有不同）。 - 参照组由因子的第一个水平决定（我们在第 3 步已设好）。
Français - Lecture de l’OR : OR = 2 → cotes d’AVC doublées vs la référence ; OR = 1 → pas d’association. OR ≠ risque relatif : proches si l’événement est rare, sinon l’OR exagère. - En R : glm(..., family = binomial) ; confint.default() donne l’IC de Wald (confint() : vraisemblance profilée, légèrement différent). - La référence est le 1er niveau du facteur (défini à l’étape 3).


Code
# 换成更有意义的单位 / unités plus parlantes
model_df <- adults %>%
  mutate(age10     = age / 10,                    # 每增加 10 岁 / par 10 ans
         glucose10 = avg_glucose_level / 10,      # 每增加 10 mg/dL / par 10 mg/dL
         bmi5      = bmi / 5)                     # 每增加 5 kg/m² / par 5 kg/m²

# 完整案例：粗 OR 与调整 OR 使用同一批人才可比
# cas complets : mêmes personnes pour brut et ajusté, pour être comparables
cc <- model_df %>% filter(!is.na(bmi))

adj_formula <- stroke ~ age10 + hypertension + heart_disease + glucose10 + bmi5 +
                        gender + ever_married + smoking_status + Residence_type

# 从 glm 结果提取 OR 表 / extraire le tableau d'OR d'un glm
or_table <- function(fit) {
  co <- coef(summary(fit))
  ci <- confint.default(fit)                       # Wald 区间 / IC de Wald
  tibble(terme = rownames(co), OR = exp(co[, "Estimate"]),
         ic95_bas = exp(ci[, 1]), ic95_haut = exp(ci[, 2]), p = co[, "Pr(>|z|)"]) %>%
    filter(terme != "(Intercept)")
}

# ① 调整 OR：所有变量一起 / OR ajustés : toutes les variables ensemble
fit_adj <- glm(adj_formula, data = cc, family = binomial)
adj_tbl <- or_table(fit_adj)

# ② 粗 OR：每个变量单独 / OR bruts : une variable à la fois
vars <- c("age10", "hypertension", "heart_disease", "glucose10", "bmi5",
          "gender", "ever_married", "smoking_status", "Residence_type")
crude_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(vars, function(v) {
  or_table(glm(reformulate(v, response = "stroke"), data = cc, family = binomial))
}))

# 更易读的名称 / libellés lisibles

  age10 = "âge (par 10 ans)", hypertension = "hypertension (oui vs non)",
  heart_disease = "cardiopathie (oui vs non)", glucose10 = "glycémie (par 10 mg/dL)",

text:
8.2 局限性 / Limites

横断面观察数据：无时间先后，只能谈关联；可能存在反向因果。 Données transversales observationnelles : pas de chronologie ; causalité inverse possible.
样本很可能不是随机人群样本：中风率 ≈ 5%（成人 ≈ 5.8%）远高于一般人群，不能用来估计患病率。 Échantillon probablement non aléatoire : taux d’AVC (~5 %) très supérieur à la population générale → aucune estimation de prévalence.
事件数少：仅 249 例中风，许多亚组事件极少，区间宽。 Peu d’événements : 249 AVC ; nombreux sous-groupes avec très peu d’événements.
变量定义不明：血糖（空腹？）、高血压（诊断？）、吸烟 Unknown。 Définitions floues : glycémie (à jeun ?), hypertension (diagnostiquée ?), tabac Unknown.
BMI 缺失很可能非随机：任何处理都可能有偏（见敏感性分析）。 IMC manquant probablement non aléatoire : tout traitement peut biaiser.
缺少关键变量：家族史、用药、饮食、运动、吸烟量（包年）、中风类型与发病时间。 Variables absentes : antécédents familiaux, traitements, alimentation, activité, paquets-années, type et date de l’AVC.
数据集来源与采集方式未充分说明，外推需谨慎。 Provenance et collecte insuffisamment documentées : prudence pour toute généralisation.
